about.title: About {{app}}
about.description: Virtual machine manager for Linux, built on QEMU/KVM and libvirt.
about.notice: {{app}} is a community project inspired by the interface and features of VMware Workstation. It is not affiliated with VMware or Broadcom and does not reuse any of their code or graphical elements.
